Vendored browser bundle for the Launch tab. The site does not need a build step.
Regenerate only by rebundling these exact package versions.

@solana/web3.js@1.98.4
@solana/spl-token@0.4.15

sha256 solana-bundle.js
161f6a379dce13027b885d9b1d34169bc6ff040c4cd8a85acb96d15fd9b2b094

The bundle is served from this site (script-src 'self'), so a third-party CDN and an SRI
script tag are not used. The hash above is the pin.
